@@U01058@@
Yes, but just one more glance in the glass.
That woman’s image was too beautiful for words!

@@U01060@@
No, no! You'll see her soon in the flesh,
that paragon of all earthly beauty.

@@U01061@@
(Aside.)

@@U01062@@
With that swill in his belly,
every housewife will look a 海伦 to him.

@@U01064@@
浮士德 advances on 格蕾琴 as she passes by.

@@U01066@@
Lovely lady,
may I offer you my arm
and be your escort?

@@U01068@@
I’m neither lovely nor a lady.
And I can get home without your help, thank you.

@@U01069@@
(She disengages herself and goes out.)

@@U01071@@
Great Heaven, what a beautiful child!
I’ve never seen anything like her.
Modest, virtuous, unspoiled,
but not without some snap in her, too.
The red of her lips, her cheeks’ glow—
can I ever forget them?
And the way she cast down her eyes
stirred me to the core.
And the way she cut me short!
Enchanting!
translation:
@@U01058@@
是的，但只是再看一眼。
那女人的形象美得无法用言语来形容！

@@U01060@@
不，不！你很快就会见到她的真身，
世间一切美丽的典范。

@@U01061@@
（旁边。）

@@U01062@@
肚子里还有那口水，
每个家庭主妇在他眼里都是海伦。

@@U01064@@
当格蕾琴经过时，浮士德向她靠近。

@@U01066@@
可爱的女士，
我可以向你伸出我的手臂吗
并成为你的护卫？

@@U01068@@
我既不可爱，也不淑女。
不用你帮忙我也能回家，谢谢你。

@@U01069@@
（她挣脱束缚，走出去。）

@@U01071@@
伟大的天堂，多么美丽的孩子啊！
我从来没有见过像她这样的人。
谦虚、善良、不被玷污，
但她也有一些脾气。
她的嘴唇红了，脸颊红了——
我能忘记他们吗？
还有她垂下眼帘的样子
深深地震撼了我。
还有她打断我的方式！
妖娆！
